findings.text: follow-on: the thumbnail fallback answers Cache-Control twice — `no-store` from `_send` (reckon/serve.py:3340) followed by `max-age=31536000, immutable` — and `no-store` forbids storing the response at all (RFC 9111 s5.2.2.5), so the immutable directive this node adds on that branch is inert and the figure is refetched on every view. Reachable whenever `_render_thumbnail` raises — a malformed figure, a codec-less source — the branch the sibling comment at reckon/serve.py:3466 says is deliberately supported. Receipt: a probe against this revision (worktree at 3c7a891f4, module_file .../a-figure-revision-is-fetched-once/reckon/serve.py) requesting /_thumb/sample/figures/demo/broken.png?rev=<current> printed `Cache-Control: no-store` then `Cache-Control: max-age=31536000, immutable`. Not blocking: `_send_file` and a rendered thumbnail do answer immutable, and the declared gate passes.

follow-on: `assert row["revision"] == project.revision()` compares the row's token against the same helper that produced it (`project.revision()` at tests/test_a_figure_revision_is_fetched_once.py:76 calls `serve._file_revision`, reckon/serve.py:2973, which `_discover_plans_uncached` also calls at reckon/serve.py:2557), so the two sides move together: a `_file_revision` returning any non-empty constant would satisfy line 125 and line 126 alike. The assertion cannot catch a regression in the token; the suite catches a degenerate token only indirectly through `assert current != previous` at tests/test_a_figure_revision_is_fetched_once.py:162.

FINDING reckon/serve.py:3475 follow-on: the thumbnail fallback answers Cache-Control twice (`no-store` from _send at reckon/serve.py:3340, then `max-age=31536000, immutable`), so `no-store` nullifies the immutable directive the change adds on that branch and such a figure is refetched on every view.
FINDING tests/test_a_figure_revision_is_fetched_once.py:125 follow-on: the row-token assertion compares against the same helper that produced the value (serve._file_revision), so it holds for any non-empty return including a constant and cannot catch a regression in the token.
